name: ARB_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS
description: The ARB_SYSTEM_PARAMETERS table contains customizations to Oracle Fusion Bill Management. This table stores installation-wide options. At least one row must always exist in this table.

columns.name: SYSTEM_PARAMETER_ID
columns.description: System parameter identifier.

columns.name: FILTER_NOT_PRINT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the transactions was identified as Do Not Print.

columns.name: FILTER_TRX_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days to filter transactions.

columns.name: AGING_BUCKET_ID
columns.description: Aging bucket identifier.

columns.name: APPLY_CREDIT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether applying credit memo to invoices is enable or not.

columns.name: PAYMENT_APPROVAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether approval is required before paying transactions.

columns.name: CROSS_BU_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment is enabled for across busines unit.

columns.name: SERVICE_CHARGE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether service charge is enabled or not.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_GRACE_DAYS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the discount grace days is used to calculate the discount.

columns.name: ZERO_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether zero amount payment is enable or not.

columns.name: MAX_FUTURE_PAYMENT_DAYS
columns.description: Indicates the maximum number of days for future payment.

columns.name: REG_HOLD_DOMAIN
columns.description: Indicates if user exceeded maximum number of attempts to register.

columns.name: REG_HOLD_DAYS
columns.description: Indicates the wait time before user can attempt to register.

columns.name: ACCT_ACCESS_APPROVAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if approval is required when requesting account access.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
